title: The Canonical Society Theorem: Subject Generation Without Preinstalled Individuals, Complete Constitutional Disposition, and Strict Progress of Freedom

additional_titles.title: 典范社会总定理：无预装个体的主体生成、完备宪制处置与严格自由进展

description:
Over explicit activity traces, lineage rules, and whole-ledger obligation contracts, this paper constructs an inhabited family of canonical societies S_h (h in N) proving that subject generation without preinstalled individuals, a fourfold constitutional root law, genuine extra-role exit, all-depth regeneration, and strict progress of realized freedom hold jointly. First, enduring subjects arise directly via the canonical lineage quotient bijection from trace-witnessed activity seeds, uniformly recovering provenance and six lifecycle obligation transitions across economic, biological, multi-agent, and strategic traces. Second, every complete installed program's generated execution is exhausted by presentation, bearer-retaining refusal, action, and same-source revision, with actual writing holding iff action or revision occurs and never both, barring any fifth off-ledger channel while uniting external-payment execution, universal classification, and two-tier conditional amendment at one constitutional point c_m. Third, at every depth d in N, one payment carries six regeneration guarantees into the exact entry of depth d + 1; along every position and every lawful payment of any registered cycle, the full contract enters that payment's actual target, retaining the entire earlier frontier while realizing a fresh occurrence beyond the old authority image, with cofinal single-step joint amendment and paid new birth beyond every finite cutoff.

Paired impossibility and observer-kernel theorems prove every provenance condition indispensable. Missing payment incidence, broken routes, and capture yield indistinguishable "three zeros" (K = 0), while complete and health-deficient two-domain portfolios yield indistinguishable "two ones" (K = 1); even full-domain reachability admits an involution kernel blocking decoders across arbitrary output universes and post-processing encodings, whereas retaining the source failure kind restores unique effective repair and splits unit-counting probability from 1/2 into 1 and 0. More generally, on the society observer and across arbitrary carriers and hidden authority fibers, any rule with an Arrow, Gibbard–Satterthwaite, or Sen visible axiom witness has no occurrence-authority-complete strengthening. The same obstruction applies to positive bilateral matching (7, 7) and trace-supported narratives. On an inhabited visible domain, a visible axiom witness does not entail hidden-fiber factorization. Finally, rule revision migrates live obligations across the first write until native performance settles them, separating renewal exhaustion, local halting, and joint settlement, while every conservative sequential target of the exhausted three-row ledger satisfies 0 <= B' <= 0. Every exercise of power must account for its bearers, and every new possibility requires its own actual source.

additional_descriptions.description:
在显式给定的活动轨迹、谱系规则与整账责任合同上，本文构造一族非空的典范社会 S_h（h 属于自然数），证明不预设先验个体的主体生成、四分宪制完备根法、真实角色外退出、全深度同发生续生与严格自由进展在同一数学结构中共同成立。第一，持续主体由轨迹内活动种子的谱系商双射直接生成，在经济、生物、多主体与博弈四类轨迹上统一恢复来源与六类生命周期责任变迁。第二，任意完整已安装程序的每次生成执行穷尽落入呈现、保承担者拒绝、行动与同源修订四类处置，实际写入当且仅当行动或修订且二者互斥，封死第五条账外写入通道，并在同一宪制点 c_m 同时兑现有源外部支付、全称分类与两层条件修宪。第三，每个深度的单次支付同步承担六项续生保证且精确推进至下一深度入口；沿任意已登记周期的每一位置与每一笔合规付款，完整制度合同进入该付款自身的真实目标，保留全部既有前沿并由目标原生支付兑现旧权威像之外的新发生，且任意有限截点之后均有同一拍同步完成同源修法与有支付支持的新生。

配对的不可能性与观察核定理标定了每条承重关系的不可替代性。支付缺失、通路中断与行动受捕获产生同值的“三个零”（K = 0），完备与缺健康服务的两领域组合产生同值的“两个一”（K = 1）；连全领域可达集合读出也因来源族对合核而阻断经其因子化的任意输出宇宙与后处理编码解码规范修复，唯有保留来源失败种类才恢复唯一有效修复并将单位计数概率由 1/2 分化为 1 与 0。更一般地，在源生社会观察器及任意载体与隐藏权威纤维扩张上，任给携带阿罗、吉巴德—萨特斯韦特或森可见公理束见证的规则，其发生权威完备性加强为空。正值双边匹配 (7, 7) 和受迹叙事也遇到同一障碍。在非空可见域上，给定可见公理束见证仍无法导出隐藏纤维权威因子化。最后，修法将活态旧责沿首写迁至原生履行归档，严格分离续付耗尽、本地停机与共同清算结清，而三行耗尽源账的一切保守顺序目标首写预算恒锁在 0 <= B' <= 0。每次权力行使须交代承担者与后果，每次新增自由须取得自己的实际来源。

The third edition adds three main-text results and their technical proofs. Proposition 3.2 proves the seedless-renewal prohibition, factorization for four compatible pre-emission projections, and the stable–critical–anomie phase law on exact queue prefixes. Theorem 4.4 classifies active reform and constitutional revision, gives a separate terminal-rupture condition, and constructs same-occurrence proof-carrying legislation. Theorem 5.13 proves the occurrence-authority boundary for social choice, positive visible matching, and trace-supported narratives. The bilingual edition includes nine vector figures and a forty-entry bibliography. Paper text and figures are CC BY 4.0. Original code and formalization are Apache-2.0.
